desc: 奶白湿润瓷沿加浅水青瓷砖带的双支海绵刷，靠孔隙与构造说服
leaf: 奶瓶奶嘴海绵清洁刷（长支大海绵头加短支小海绵头双支，硬塑手柄带闭合挂环与鼓形握段，刷头为带纵向深沟的矩形海绵块）
name: 奶白瓷沿浅水珊瑚奶瓶刷双支款

shots.intent: 首屏一眼点击：两支不同尺寸的海绵刷斜搭在湿润瓷沿上，挂环、鼓形握段与沟槽刷头一次看清，尺寸差自己说话。
shots.textZone: headline 「{selling_point_1}」 left-aligned with one small solid coral #E4735C sponge block before it, sub-line 「{callout_1}」 under a short hairline coral rule, and a right-margin vertical index of three blank coral hairline sponge marks carrying 「{callout_2}」 and 「{callout_3}」

shots.intent: 把清洗奶瓶奶嘴最常见的四条顾虑压成一列珊瑚海绵线稿与短标签，一屏让家长对号入座，主张全部走占位符。
shots.textZone: headline 「{selling_point_2}」 upper-left with one coral sponge block before it, four stacked label placeholders 「{callout_4}」 beside the four hairline marks; every concern carried by a placeholder, nothing asserted as fact

shots.intent: 同机位同光双栏正侧影，让买家自己看见大刷头配高瓶身、小刷头配矮奶嘴圈的尺寸对应关系，不写任何材质与功效断言。
shots.textZone: headline 「{selling_point_3}」 in the upper band preceded by one coral sponge block, one short label per panel 「{callout_5}」 above and 「{callout_6}」 below at 13pt; no badges, no data arrows, no tick or cross marks

shots.intent: 把双支刷放回真实洗台动线：俯角看进盆沿，湿瓷、清水瓶与斜搁的刷柄完成代入，全程无人手无面孔。
shots.textZone: one small caption placeholder 「{callout_7}」 in deep aqua-ink #2E474B at 12pt near the lower-right with one hairline coral leader, nothing else

shots.intent: 斜射微距直视海绵头的开孔壁与纵向深沟底，用可见孔结构与沟槽承担品质证据，替代一切材质等级与数值。
shots.textZone: one short label 「{callout_8}」 at 13pt in the upper shadow zone with one hairline coral leader ending in one small coral sponge dot, nothing else

shots.intent: 沿刷柄自下仰视，把闭合挂环、鼓形握段与进入海绵的细颈接杆三段构造一次交代清楚，做工即证据。
shots.textZone: headline 「{selling_point_4}」 in the upper-left aqua zone in milk #FBFCF9 preceded by one coral sponge block, three short leader labels 「{callout_9}」 at 12pt resting on the loop, the grip bulge and the rod neck; no dimension figure

shots.intent: 用一张印在雾白卡面上的空参数表与一枚空白提示框承接规格与信息位，把全部数字交回占位符，不写任何数值与证号。

shots.intent: 以正俯视双支并置与一枚短按钮把浏览转成加购，主张与优惠全部走占位符，只靠版面节奏结束详情页。
